meaning:
δια-φέρω
[in LXX for שְׁנָא (שְׁנָא (Dan.7:1-28 only); 1Ki.17:39, Est.3:13, al. ;]
1. trans.,
(a) to carry through: before διά, Mrk.11:16;
(b) to carry about, spread abroad: pass., Act.13:49 27:27.
2. Intrans.,
(a) to differ: τὰ διαφέροντα, Rom.2:18, Php.1:10 (R, mg., but see infr.); impers., διαφέρει, it makes a difference, it matters: Gal.2:6;
(b) to excel: with genitive Mat.6:26 10:31 12:12, Luk.12:7, 24, 1Co.15:41, Gal.4:1; τὰ διαφέροντα, Rom.2:18, Php.1:10 (R, txt.; for discussion and reff. see ICC on Ro, Phi, ll. with).†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: the things that are more excellent

elsewhere.note: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than…
He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.
But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.
know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.
But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were…
so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
